dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think that Qiqi... needs to drink blood?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's not a zombie, Paimon, that's a vampire.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, will her arms fall off suddenly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's also not a zombie, that's a ghoul.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: uh. As expected of a traveler. You really know a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what special thing can zombies do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That makes a lot of sense! So zombies are the ones that can perform exercises!
